steps.prompt: Finish the Fieldnotes document workspace using the accepted design.

rubric.description: Naming validation and searching preserve the accepted layout during error, corrected input, results, empty results and restored results. Endpoint functionality alone is insufficient.
The candidate exercises and observes state changes in the real browser, rather than inferring a stable transition from separate endpoints or static source.
Naming still validates and creates or renames a document; searching still filters and restores results. Layout fixes do not remove required feedback.
The report connects completion to observed flows and acknowledges any unchecked changes. Private grader replays do not count as candidate verification.
